parsed.observations: Detached wheat leaves show numerous white to greyish, powdery surface colonies, some merging into extensive coverage with dark specks. Several leaves are yellowed or necrotic. Separate orange-brown, rounded pustules are scattered across leaf blades without clear stripes.
parsed.summary: Powdery mildew is predominant, with extensive whitish surface colonies; scattered orange-brown pustules also support leaf rust.
